title: Amazing to get things done
body: I really love this app. It has changee my life and has enabled me to get a lot more work done each day more than ever. However, I wish the desktop app would be more...desktopy rather than having the same mobile phone look. I also hope the devs also let the desktop notification sounds actually sound like the ones used in the custom settins rather than using the default MacOS notifcation sound. Overall I am glad this app exists. 5 Stars!
author: TronikaXP
